name: AI Search Block Header
description: Header search form that redirects to the AI Search page with a query and auto-runs the AI block.
project_description: AI Search Block Header provides a compact, core-search-styled header block that does not run the LLM itself. It renders a small search input; on submit it redirects to a configured destination path (the page carrying the full AI Search block) with the query appended as ?ai_search_block_q=. An auto-run script on the destination page reads that parameter, populates the AI Search input, and submits it so the answer streams immediately. This lets you offer a persistent header search entry point that lands visitors on a dedicated AI answer page. Depends on AI Search Block.
